assets.label: Command crest
assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: finished horizontal banner logo for the original space strategy game Stellar Syndicates.
Canvas: wide 3:1 landscape banner, ideally 2400 x 800, one finished design filling the canvas.
Brand context: an interstellar strategy game about colonies, industry, commerce, fleets, and competing syndicates. Existing branding uses a dark hexagonal steel emblem, angular interlocking S forms, a brilliant cyan four-point star and orbit, a small gold accent above and red accent below. Project colors: midnight navy #05070d, pale cool silver, cyan #4fc3ff, restrained warm gold.
Text (verbatim, the only text in the image): "STELLAR SYNDICATES". Spell exactly S T E L L A R, then S Y N D I C A T E S. Highly legible, large custom uppercase typography with precise optical kerning.
Constraints: polished original game branding, a strong silhouette, balanced negative space, crisp typography that stays readable at small sizes, generous safe margin around all logo elements. No captions, subtitles, taglines, sample labels, watermarks, mockup setting, contact sheet, UI or additional words.
Design direction: COMMAND CREST. A premium hard science-fiction game title treatment. A compact, beautifully constructed gunmetal hexagonal emblem with angular interlocking forms suggesting two S letters around one cyan four-point star; a thin luminous orbital ellipse and a small gold apex accent. Pair the emblem with a much wider two-line wordmark: STELLAR above SYNDICATES, both lines visually balanced in width. Use muscular geometric letterforms, subtle brushed titanium faces, restrained beveled edges and cyan reflected light. The crest and wordmark form one centered horizontal lockup with the emblem occupying about one quarter of the lockup width and the text the remainder. Background is near-black midnight navy with a very subtle cool atmospheric glow. Keep the logo dominant and the field quiet. Sophisticated restrained dimensional rendering; no huge extrusion, no excessive lens flare or decorative clutter.

Design direction: ORBITAL WORDMARK. A sleek modern typographic banner with a flat, graphic, almost vector-like treatment. The large two-line wordmark is the hero: wide-tracked STELLAR over the larger-width SYNDICATES, with carefully aligned outer edges and bold architectural letterforms in pale silver. Integrate a tiny precise four-point cyan star into the typography and a single graceful cyan orbital arc that sweeps around the wordmark without obscuring a single letter. An understated small abstract angular S orbital symbol is integrated into the overall centered composition, not a bulky badge. Rich nearly black navy background, restrained fine star specks and subtle dark blue atmosphere at the perimeter. The design should feel elegant, intelligent and built for an enduring strategy-game brand, not an esports team. Minimal crisp shapes, outstanding readable lettering, one disciplined visual idea.

Design direction: SYNDICATE GOLD. An elegant futuristic corporate-imperial banner, expressing the power of rival interstellar trading houses. A refined geometric star-and-hexagon crest with angular interlocking S-inspired forms, built from satin champagne gold and dark steel with one tiny cyan core. Pair this with a commanding custom uppercase wordmark reading STELLAR on the first line and SYNDICATES on the second, the lines optically balanced as one horizontal emblem-and-wordmark composition. Lettering is warm pale metallic gold with precise chamfered corners, broad proportions, fine restrained engraved detail, and understated shallow dimensionality. Background is matte midnight navy, a little dark material grain and extremely subtle topographic/orbital-line geometry at the far edges. Crisp luxurious restraint, balanced symmetry within the crest, confident negative space, high-end science-fiction strategy branding. No crowns, eagles, wreaths, extra symbols or busy scenery.
